findings.6: We disagree with this finding and keep the fakes as they are. The linked test holds one definition of each kernel entry point: the fakes sit in the test's own object, the real kernel object inside the static library, and the linker extracts an archive member only for a symbol still undefined. findings.9: Both facts hold; the stride static_assert landed in 4290402491, and the duplication stays by agreement with Ben. The static_assert checks that sizeof(s_pages) equals 4 rows x 64 floats x 4 bytes (self_attention.hpp:1500-1502 at that commit), which forces the rows to be consecutive with no padding, the property both kernels rely on when they take &s_pages[0][0] with row stride page_size. On the duplicated step: Ben and I compared the two paths side by side in a walkthrough, noted that the per-head softmax and commit loops differ (the AMX path folds the PV kernel's output where the dotter folds scaled_v inside the same loop), and agreed to keep the current split; his thread 3936986164 is resolved on that basis. On the NaN asserts, the comparison mixes stages: the dotter's per-page step has no assert either, and the join_page_ranges asserts check the state either path produced.

extra.hugepage: Agreed on the direction: if the mirror is reconsidered, the K copy moves into the hugepage pool; under your single-format VNNI K store (single-K) the question disappears. The paragraph and the arena are no longer in #3879; since the 2026-09-08 split the K mirror arena sits in a local reference draft that is not pushed. The arena was ordinary RAM on purpose, so that it would not reduce the KV page count, but that choice also hid it from the memory-pressure governor. Last week's systems-test round showed the cost: the arena reached 43.8 GB at 30 minutes and a 46.5 GB peak on one tp2 engine, host used memory grew by up to 42.3 GiB, and the soak monitor raised its 5 GiB growth alert, while the AMX-off arm stayed flat. Two forms of the fix: the VNNI copy as a third plane inside kv_block, as your bill-amx branch does with k_vnni, or a separate allocation from the pool through the helper the KV book already uses (try_make_unique_dma_for_overwrite); either way the governor counts the copy with no new code, and the pool grows by half the KV bytes. The 2026-09-16 gate (VNNI store cost, GOF staging cost) decides between the mirror draft and your single-format store; the results of last week's round tilt it toward single-K.
